results.summary_before: This project implements a spiking neural network with 18 programmable digital LIF neurons and 144 synapses arranged in three fully connected layers. The design is notable for being generated by ChatGPT and for its use of programmable delays, but it lacks silicon test results.
results.summary: This project implements a systolic array model of leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neurons in Verilog. The design uses weight-stationary multiply-accumulate (MAC) units with bypass logic to prevent overstimulation of the LIF neurons. The user input ui_in drives the MAC inputs, and the output bits indicate the LIF state and spike events. The design has not been tested on silicon.

results.summary: This project implements a (7, 1/2) convolutional encoder following the CCSDS 131.0-B-4 standard. The encoder is a half-rate code with constraint length seven, generating two output bits for every input bit. It is implemented in Wokwi and uses a 7-segment display to show the encoded output. Testing involves writing a 6-bit input and shifting to observe the encoded symbols.
